title: TP-doctrine baseline grew 50->77 in 3 PRs on 10-27 although it 'may only shrink'; nothing detects a baseline edit
note: WEEKLY-AUDIT-2026-10-28 C2. MEASURED from git show of scripts/ci/check_tp_doctrine.py BASELINE_2026_10_06 per commit: 50 (38a752038, 10-24) -> 51 (#20481) -> 53 (#20551) -> 75 (#20561 DEMO-FLOOR RULE) -> 77 (#20668). All 3 were operator-approved Tier-3 roster PRs; each added its new non-compliant routings to the baseline in the same diff, so the guard's 'NEW non-compliant routing FAILS' rule never fired. Current: 0 of 77 routings compliant (real-money 0/6, prop 0/6, mirror 0/5, paper 0/60). Fix (Tier 1): a guard that fails when len(BASELINE) on the PR head > base ref unless the PR body/landing file carries an explicit tp_debt_added list (so growth is a visible decision, never a side effect). Detector = that guard + a self-test planting one added line. check: count BASELINE entries on main next week; rule: growth only with a tp_debt_added record. [DEEP-AUDIT-20261104 L0] call HIT, action MOVING: check_tp_doctrine --strict: baseline 77 -> 72 entries, compliant 0/77 -> 3/75 (real money 1/7, prop 0/3, mirror 1/7, paper 1/58). The guard already reports per-route DEBT GROWTH (check_tp_doctrine.py:810); a baseline-ENTRY growth check is still missing and is a gate (AUD-20261104-DETECTOR-IS-A-GATE).
